info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Account Reconciliation API
info.description: The Account Reconciliation API facilitates the process of aligning and verifying financial records within banking operations. This API provides access to reconciliation data, enabling businesses to ensure their account balances are accurate and consistent across systems. Financial institutions and accounting departments are typical consumers of this API, utilizing it to enhance their financial reporting and compliance efforts. By streamlining data retrieval, this API supports improved decision-making and operational efficiency in account management.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about account reconciliation, providing insights into transaction balances and discrepancies. Useful for auditing and financial assessments.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate the account reconciliation process. It should contain the necessary parameters to identify the accounts involved in the reconciliation and any other relevant details required for processing.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the account reconciliation data.
